exact_scope: For each fixed iid space-time law with 0<p<1 almost surely, the one-dimensional nearest-neighbor quenched and annealed endpoint laws on deterministic real intervals of every length sequence M_N tending to infinity have fixed-tolerance environmental discrepancy probability O(N^-K) for every K, uniformly in deterministic alignment. No uniformity over laws or environment-selected partitions, no microscopic local limit, and no verified novelty/priority claim. Full L1 discrepancy, law-dependent constants and sequence-dependent eventual thresholds are retained.
